messages:
sara.m: FYI Acme escalated — after the recent keystore update they report missing audit rows older than ~45 days and decrypt errors when accessing archived blobs.

support-bot: Created ticket C-4821 (P1). Logs attached.

acme.ops: "We saw decrypt failures starting 03:12 UTC. Example: `decrypt error: MAC verification failed (keyid: 0x9a7b...)`. Also audit UI shows gaps between 2024-08-15 and 2024-09-03. Our retention is 90d; these rows should be present."

alex.k: tagging eng-infra + security. @devin.r did the keystore patch rotate keys or change unwrap semantics?

devin.r: We rolled libcrypto 1.2.3 -> 1.2.4 at ~02:00 UTC. It includes a changed keywrap/unwrap path and updated AES-GCM. No KEK rotations in that job. Canary was 1% for 30m, no automatic rollback.

alex.k: paste exact prod traces pls.

devin.r: sample from archiver node:
```
2026-03-17T03:12:44Z ERROR keystore: unwrap failed key=0x9a7b... err="MAC verification failed"
2026-03-17T03:12:44Z WARN archive: decryption failed, skipping payload id=p-34827
```

mia.s: This is a compliance impact — if archives can't be decrypted we must halt retention deletions for affected customers and notify legal.

sara.m: Customer asks: (1) why rows missing, (2) can we recover, (3) ETA for fix + impact to audit attestation.

devin.r: Triage plan:
- stop retention-cleaner for Acme: `systemctl stop retention-cleaner@acme.service`
- run legacy unwrap tool preserved for compatibility: `/opt/redwood/bin/kw-legacy-unwrap --key 0x9a7b... --in /mnt/archives/p-34827.wrapped --out /tmp/p-34827.bin`
- if legacy unwrap works, rewrap and re-ingest; otherwise escalate to HSM vendor.

ops-lead: Pausing retention runs for all customers with >60d backlog. @sara.m confirm pause to Acme.

sara.m: Pause confirmed. Sent customer note; they want repro steps and ETA.

hsm-vendor-bot: Created vendor ticket VND-9123. Initial analysis: no firmware change on vendor side. Deep analysis ETA ~2h.

devin.r: Legacy unwrap succeeded on 3/5 samples; 2 still fail with MAC errors for different keyids. Partial recovery possible.

alex.k: Two options: rollback libcrypto to 1.2.3 on affected archivers (est. 30-45m), or wait vendor patch. Ops scheduling rollback at 05:00 UTC.

mia.s: Capture audit-index snapshot before touching anything: `curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" https://audit.internal/v1/index | jq . > /tmp/audit-index.json` — store in vault for attestation.

devin.r: Running canary rewrap (100 blobs): 35/100 rewrapped, no failures so far. Will scale if green.

sara.m: Notified customer: pausing deletions, taking snapshots, rollback+recovery. They requested daily status updates and an incident call at 08:00 UTC.

ops-lead: Retention jobs paused, disk stable. No new decrypt errors on canary nodes.

hsm-vendor-bot: Vendor deep-dive: unwrap acceptance tolerant behavior changed in libcrypto 1.2.4 for certain padding variants; full vendor report ETA 1h.

alex.k: Assignments: @devin.r lead rollback+rewrap, @ops-lead hold retention, @mia.s own compliance comms, @sara.m customer comms. Keep logs for postmortem.

devin.r: Starting rollback runbook now, collecting `/var/log/keystore/rollback-{node}.log` to ticket. Will update when batch completes.

support-bot: Ticket C-4821 updated: state=investigating, sla_p1=true, next_update=2026-03-17T08:00:00Z

alex.k: Thanks. After recovery we'll produce a postmortem describing root cause, timeline, and mitigations (test vectors, canary gating, rollback playbook).
